questions.text: Do you work, or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your work or studies?
Is there anything you would like to change about it?
What do you usually do in the first hour after you wake up?
Has your morning routine changed since you were a child?
Do you think it is important to eat breakfast? Why?
How often do you go to a park?
What do people usually do in parks in your country?
Would you like there to be more parks where you live? Why or why not?

cue_card.task: Describe a time when an older person taught you something useful.
cue_card.and_explain: and explain why it was useful to you.

rounding_off.text: Do you still use this skill today?

questions.text: What kinds of skills do older people usually pass on to younger people in your country?
Are young people today as willing to learn from older people as they were in the past? Why or why not?
Some people say that, because of technology, older people now learn more from the young than the other way round. Do you agree?
Should schools invite older members of the community to teach some lessons? Why?
What might be lost if traditional skills are no longer passed on?
